title: Labor Day Weekend Double Station Cash
names_seen: Labor Day Weekend Double Station Cash
Labor Day weekend Double Station Cash

facts.statement: For the Labor Day weekend, purchases of Station Cash (in-game or online) gave double the amount of Station Cash.
facts.quote: Ihr bekommt zwischen dem 1.-3. September, 2012 doppeltes Station Cash!

facts.statement: SOE ran a Labor Day weekend promotion where Station Cash purchases were doubled, valid from 12:01 AM PDT on 1 September 2012 to 11:59 PM PDT on 3 September 2012.
facts.quote: ¡Obtener DOBLE STATION CASH entre 01 de septiembre y 3 de septiembre de 2012!

facts.statement: A Labor Day weekend promotion gave double Station Cash to players who bought Station Cash in-game, online, or redeemed a prepaid Station Cash card.
facts.quote: Ganhe o dobro de Station Cash entre primeiro de Setembro e dia 3 de Setembro de 2012

facts.statement: The promotion period is written as starting at 04:01 on '9/1/2012' and ending 03:59 on 03/09/12; the start date is ambiguous and conflicts with the 1 to 3 September wording.
facts.quote: Oferta válida apartir de 04:01 do dia 9/1/2012 até às 03:59 do dia 03/09/12

article_summaries.title: Doppeltes Station Cash am "Labor Day"-Wochenende!
article_summaries.summary: A German-language freerealms.com news post announcing double Station Cash for the Labor Day weekend, valid for purchases in-game or online from 1 to 3 September 2012. The offer does not apply to Station Cash bought by SMS. The post's exact publication date is not shown; the page only says it was published about 2 months and 2 days before capture (captured 2012-11-03).

article_summaries.title: Fin de semana del Día del Trabajo Doble Station Cash!
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post (Spanish-language text under a Portuguese page title) announcing a Labor Day weekend promotion giving double Station Cash. The offer ran 1-3 September 2012 and excluded SMS-paid Station Cash purchases. The page says it was posted '2 months, 2 days ago' relative to the capture, so the exact posting date is not stated.

article_summaries.title: Labor Day Weekend Double Station Cash!
article_summaries.summary: A Portuguese-language Free Realms news post (captured from the Brazilian/Portuguese news listing) announcing a Labor Day weekend promotion that doubled Station Cash purchases. Station Cash top-ups made in-game, online, or by redeeming a prepaid Station Cash card were eligible; SMS purchases were excluded. The date range in the post is internally inconsistent, so exact start and end should be verified against other sources.
